0.name: ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES
0.introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and your arms stretched forward. 

Then lift your upper body off the floor. Hold for a few seconds and slowly return. 

It primarily works the rectus abdominis muscle and the obliques.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Use your abdominal strength.
You will get better results if you do it slowly.
Relax your neck.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
It's not right to use your arms to propel your body upwards.
To fully engage your abs, please don't use explosive strength.
Exhale when raising, and inhale when lowering.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your abdominal muscles burning.
You shouldn't feel your neck is sore.
It's a good workout for your abs.

1.name: LEG RAISES
1.introduce:
Lie down on your back, and put your hands beneath your hips for support. 

Then lift your legs up until they form a right angle with the floor. 

Slowly bring your legs back down and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Raise up your legs faster and put them down slower.
Your back should always be flat on the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as possible.
Don't pull your shoulders up off the floor.
Exhale when lifting your legs, and inhale when lowering them.
If you feel it's too hard, put a little bend in your knees.
You shouldn't feel any pressure in your chest and shoulder area.
This exercise targets your lower abdominals.

3.name: PLANK
3.introduce:
Lie on the floor with your toes and forearms on the ground. Keep your body straight and hold this position as long as you can. 

Don't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

This exercise strengthens the abdomen, back and shoulders.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your core and gluteus.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Breathe naturally.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your lower back.
Too hard? Lower your knees on the mat with your ankles crossed in the air.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
It's not right if your shoulders or lower back are sore.
This exercise works your core.
This exercise is good for your spine.

4.name: REVERSE CRUNCHES
4.introduce: Lie on your back with your knees up at a 90 degree angle and your hands behind your head. \n\nLift your upper body and thighs, and then stretch out. Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Use your abdominal strength.
Try to touch your knees to your nose.
Don't bring your elbows to your knees.
Don't pull your lower back up off the floor.
Put your hands behind your ears, don't interlock your fingers.
Lift your shoulders as you exhale and lower them as you inhale.
You shouldn't feel too  much strain in your neck.
This really targets your lower abdominals.

6.name: LONG ARM CRUNCHES
6.introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms straight over the top of your head. \n\nLift your upper body off the floor, then slowly go back to the start position. The exercise increases abdominal endurance.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Your lower back should always be on the floor.
Use your abdominal strength.
Don't use your arms to propel your body upwards.
Exhale when you lift and inhale when you lower.
Too easy? Hold a dumbbell in your hands.
Your neck should not feel sore.

7.name: RUSSIAN TWIST
7.introduce: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet lifted a little bit and back tilted backwards.\n\nThen hold your hands together and twist from side to side.

tips.text: We suggest that you do this on a mat.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Keep your legs still.
Tighten your abs.
Don't move your legs when twisting.
Breathe naturally.
To get more of a challenge, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, put your feet on the floor.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your obliques.

8.name: BICYCLE CRUNCHES
8.introduce: Lie on the floor with your hands behind your ears. Raise your knees and close your right elbow toward your left knee, then close your left elbow toward your right knee. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominals.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Put your hands behind your ears, don't interlock your fingers.
If you can see your elbows, please open your chest.
Exhale when lifting your body and inhale when lowering.
You should feel your abs burning.
You shouldn't feel too much strain in your neck.

9.name: COBRAS
9.introduce: Lie down on your stomach and bend your elbows with your hands beneath your shoulders. \n\nThen push your chest up off the ground as far as possible. Return to the start position and repeat.

tips.text: Prepare a mat first.
Tighten your abdominals.
Stretch your abdominals as much as you can.
Inhale when you go up, and exhale when you go down.
This is a great exercise to strengthen your back.

10.name: BIRD DOG
10.introduce:
Start with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. 

Inhale and let your belly relax. Then, on the exhale, engage your core to extend one arm and the opposite leg. 

Hold for five seconds, then go back and repeat with the other side, coordinating with your breaths.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your stretched arm and leg parallel to the floor.
Your toes should point toward the floor.
Tighten your abs.
Don't lift your arm or leg up too high.
This is a good exercise for your core.
This targets your abdominals and lower back.
This helps you build your endurance and get good balance.
Exhale when lifting your arm and opposite leg, and inhale when lowering them.

11.name: BRIDGE
11.introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides, palms pressing gently into the mat.

Inhale deeply, press through your feet to lift your hips off the floor. Let your chest open and gently draw it toward your chin, creating a natural arch in your back. Keep your shoulders grounded and your gaze upward. 

Hold the pose for a few breaths. With each inhale, lengthen through your spine; with each exhale, relax into the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Inhale to lengthen through your spine. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

12.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER
12.introduce: Start in the push-up position. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch from one leg to the other. \n\nThis exercise strengthens multiple muscle groups.

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don't lift your hips up.
Take steady and deep breaths.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, adjust to a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If you feel it's too hard, elevate your hands on a bench.
This is a great full body exercise.
This can strengthen your cardiovascular system.

13.name: CROSS ARM CRUNCHES
13.introduce:
Lie down and bend your knees with your feet flat on the floor. Cross your arms in front of your chest. 

Then lift your head and shoulders up to make a 30 degree angle with the ground. 

It primarily works on the rectus abdominis muscle and obliques.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
Mainly use your abdominal strength.
You shouldn't tighten your neck.
To fully engage your abs, please don't use explosive strength.
Exhale when you lift and inhale when you lower.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your abs burning.
If you feel strain in your neck, you're using the wrong muscles.
This is a good exercise for your abdominals.

15.name: JUMPING JACKS
15.introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

17.name: WALL PUSH-UPS
17.introduce: Stand in front of a wall one big step away from it. Then put your hands out straight towards the wall and lean against it. Lift your heels.\n\nSlowly bend your elbows and press your upper body towards the wall. Push back and repeat the exercise. Remember to keep your body straight.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your body straight.
Tighten your abs.
Inhale when bending your arms, and exhale when stretching them out.
To make it harder, perform a traditional push-up on the floor.
This exercise primarily targets your chest and arms.

18.name: TRICEPS DIPS
18.introduce: Sit on the edge of the chair with your hands gripping the edge. Slide your hips off the chair.\n\nInhale, slowly bend your elbows to lower your body. Exhale, push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair or bench.
Pull your shoulders back.
Open your chest.
Don't let your shoulders go forward.
Inhale when bending your arms and exhale when straighten them.
If you feel it's too easy, enlarge the distance between your feet and the chair.
You should feel your triceps engage.
This exercise really works on your arm muscles.

21.name: SQUATS
21.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms stretched forward, then lower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. 

Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes. Return to the start position and do the next rep. 

This works the thighs, hips buttocks, quads, hamstrings and lower body.

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your glutes.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If it's too easy for you, go lower for a deep squat.
If you feel it's too hard, widen your feet to get more balance.
This works on all the muscles of your lower body.
This exercise will help you get good balance.

22.name: SIDE LUNGES
22.introduce: Stand straight with your feet together. Move your right leg to the side, then lower your body while keeping your left leg straight. \n\nGo back to the start position and switch to the other side.

tips.text: Make your core tight.
Your toes should face forward.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
Too easy for you? Lift your foot when taking your leg back.
All of your leg muscles should be engaged.

24.name: LUNGES
24.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips. 

Take a step forward with your right leg and lower your body until your right thigh is parallel with the floor. 

Then return and switch to the other leg. This exercise strengthens the quadriceps, gluteus maximus and hamstrings.

tips.text: Take a big step forward.
Keep your legs at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your weight on your heels when pushing your body up.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
Enlarge the distance between your feet if your knees are sore.
All of your leg muscles should be engaged.

26.name: BURPEES
26.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, then put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward. Do a quick push-up and then jump up.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Put your hands between your knees.
Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
Don't make your elbows point outward when doing the push-up.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back and shoulders.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
It's a great exercise that we highly recommend to you.

27.name: CURTSY LUNGES
27.introduce: Stand straight up. Then step back with one leg to the other side, bending your knees at the same time.\n\nGo back to the start position and switch to the other side.

tips.text: Keep your upper body straight.
Keep your core tight.
Your weight should be on your heels.
Inhale when your go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it harder, you can do it with weights in your hands.
It works on your entire thigh area.
It can shape your legs and challenge your balance.

31.name: SPLIT SQUAT RIGHT
31.introduce: Take a big step forward with your right leg and keep your upper body straight. \n\nThen make your body go straight down and up.

tips.text: Focus on your front heel to hold your body up.
Tighten your core.
Make sure there's enough distance between your feet.
Your weight should be on your front heel.
Your upper body should stay straight.
Don't put too much pressure on your knees.
Don't lean your body forward.
Don't put your front knee past your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it harder, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, hold a chair to keep balance.
You should feel your gluteus maximus being engaged.
This is a good exercise for your butts and thighs.
This can strengthen your hips.

32.name: SPLIT SQUAT LEFT
32.introduce: Take a big step forward with your left leg and keep your upper body straight. \n\nThen make your body go straight down and up.

tips.text: Focus on your front heel to hold your body up.
Tighten your core.
Make sure there's enough distance between your feet.
Your weight should be on your front heel.
Your upper body should stay straight.
Don't put too much pressure on your knees.
Don't lean your body forward.
Don't put your front knee past your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it harder, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
If you feel it's too hard, hold a chair to keep balance.
You should feel your gluteus maximus being engaged.
This is a good exercise for your butts and thighs.
This can strengthen your hips.

33.name: HIGH STEPPING
33.introduce: Run in place while pulling your knees as high as possible with each step. \n\nKeep your upper body upright during this exercise.

tips.text: Keep your upper body straight.
Do it as fast as you can.
Don't bend your back.
Breathe naturally.
To make it harder, raise your knees as high as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, slow down.
You can feel your heartbeat quickening.
This is a great exercise for your lower body.
This cardio exercise can strengthen your heart and lungs.

34.name: KNEE PUSH-UPS
34.introduce: Start in the regular push-up position, then let your knees touch the floor and raise your feet up off the floor. \n\nNext push your body up and down.

tips.text: You need to do it on a mat.
Your body should be straight.
Tighten your abdominals.
Don't rotate your shoulders towards your chest.
Don't drop or raise your head.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
To make it more difficult, perform a traditional push-up.
Your should not feel too much pressure on your shoulders.
This exercise targets all the major muscle groups of your upper body.

36.name: WALL SIT
36.introduce:
Start with your back against the wall, then slide down until your knees are at a 90 degree angle. 

Keep your back against the wall with your hands and arms away from your legs. Hold the position. 

The exercise is to strengthen the quadriceps muscles.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Your thighs should be parallel to the floor.
Keep your back straight.
Breathe smoothly.
If you feel it's too hard, stretch your leg out slightly.
To make it harder, add weight on your thighs.
You can feel your thighs and gluteus burning, even shivering.
This exercise targets your quadriceps and gluteus.

37.name: LEFT LUNGE KNEE HOPS
37.introduce:
Stand straight up. Then step your left leg back and lower your body. 

When you come up, raise your left knee as high as you can. 

Go back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Your toes should face forward.
Make sure your front knee doesn't go over your toes.
Watch your breathing. Inhale as you go down, and exhale as you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, add a little hop when you go up.
This is a great cardiovascular exercise.

38.name: RIGHT LUNGE KNEE HOPS
38.introduce:
Stand straight up. Then step your right leg back and lower your body. 

When you come up, raise your right knee as high as you can. 

Go back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Your toes should face forward.
Make sure your front knee doesn't go over your toes.
Watch your breathing. Inhale as you go down, and exhale as you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, add a little hop when you go up.
This is a great cardiovascular exercise.

40.name: JUMPING SQUATS
40.introduce: Start in the squat position, then jump up using your abdominal muscles for strength. This exercise works your abdomen.

tips.text: Remember to use the strength of your abs.
Keep your knees extended in the same direction as your toes.
When squatting down, your chest should be higher than your hips.
Absorb the shock with your muscles when landing.
When you squat down, your knees shouldn't go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, put your hands behind your head.
To get more of a challenge, bring your feet together when jumping up.
Too easy? Raise your knees as high as you can when jumping up.
If you feel it's too hard, use your arms to help propel your body up.
It's a good exercise for your legs and gluteus.

47.name: DONKEY KICKS RIGHT
47.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under butt and your hands under shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

48.name: BUTT BRIDGE
48.introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

49.name: DONKEY KICKS LEFT
49.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg and squeeze your butt as much as you can. Go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
To get better results, keep your core tight.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your gluteus, and can also work on your hamstrings.

50.name: FIRE HYDRANT RIGHT
50.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg to the side at a 90 degree angle.

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your arms straight.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
Always keep your core tight.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
If it's too easy for you, hold your leg up for several seconds.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.
This exercise can strengthen your hips and tighten your core.

51.name: FIRE HYDRANT LEFT
51.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg to the side at a 90 degree angle.

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your arms straight.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
Always keep your core tight.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
If it's too easy for you, hold your leg up for several seconds.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.
This exercise can strengthen your hips and tighten your core.

52.name: FROGGY GLUTE LIFTS
52.introduce: Lie on your stomach with your knees bent and heels squeezed together.\n\nThen lift your feet up and down. The exercise is very effective at squeezing your butt.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core engaged.
Use the strength of your glutes when lifting your legs.
Don't lift your upper body when lifting your feet.
Exhale when lifting your feet, and inhale when lowering them.
You should feel your glutes burning.
This exercise really targets your butt.
This exercise is good for your lower back.

55.name: PLIE SQUATS
55.introduce:
Stand with your hands on your hips and feet a little wider than shoulder width apart.

Then lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. 

Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your tiptoes.

tips.text: Focus on your heels to support your body.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Don't lean your body forward.
Inhale as you squat down, and exhale as you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
This exercise strengthens your gluteus, quadriceps and hips.

57.name: GLUTE KICK BACK
57.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. \n\nThen kick one leg back until it is parallel with the ground. Switch to the other side after several sets.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your toes should point toward the floor.
Keep your lifted leg straight.
Your hands should be directly under your shoulders.
Keep your back flat.
Put your weight on your wrists.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back.
This exercise is going to give you a sexy butt.

59.name: SUMO SQUAT & LEG RAISES
59.introduce:
Start with your feet apart wider than your shoulders. 

Lower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. Your knees should be extended in line with your toes. 

When you come up, kick one leg to the side. Then repeat the exercise, switching to the other leg.

tips.text: Your knees should be in line with your toes.
Keep your core tight.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hand.
This exercise will target all the muscles of your lower body.

61.name: ARM CIRCLES
61.introduce: Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height. \n\nMove your arms forward in circles, and then move backwards.

tips.text: Keep your arms straight.
Your arms should go from small circles to big circles.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.
This exercise targets your deltoids.
This exercise really helps loosen up your shoulders.
This is a great exercise to build arm muscle endurance.

62.name: PUNCHES
62.introduce: Stand with one of your legs forward and your knees bent slightly. Bend your elbows and clench your fists in front of your face.\n\nExtend one arm forward with the palm facing the floor. Take the arm back and repeat with the other arm.

tips.text: Fully extend your arm with each punch.
Tighten your core.
Do it as fast as you can.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.

63.name: FLOOR TRICEP DIPS
63.introduce:
Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your hands beneath your shoulders with your fingers pointing toward your hips.

Lift your hips off the floor. Then bend and extend your elbows to lower and lift your hips.

Repeat the exercise to strengthen your upper arms.

tips.text: You need to do this on a mat.
Move your arms instead of moving your hips up and down.
Tighten your abs.
Don't let your hips get far away from your hands.
Inhale on the way down, and exhale on the way up.
If it's too easy for you, elevate your hands on the chair.
If it's too hard for you, put your hips on the floor.
You should feel your triceps engage.
This exercise works on your triceps.

64.name: ARM RAISES
64.introduce: Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight forward at shoulder height. \n\nExhale, raise your arms above your head. Inhale, return to the start position and repeat.

tips.text: Keep your arms straight.
Exhale when raising your arms, and inhale when lowering them.
To get more of a challenge, hold a dumbbell in each hand.
We highly recommend this great arm and shoulder exercise to you.

65.name: CHEST PRESS PULSE
65.introduce: Hold your forearms together at shoulder height and bend your elbows with your hands together to make an \'L\' shape.\n\nThen lift your forearms up and down.

tips.text: Your elbows should be at shoulder height.
Squeeze your forearms together.
Breathe regularly.
Too easy? Try harder to push your forearms together.
If your arms are sore, don't worry, it's working.
This exercise works on your shoulders and biceps.

69.name: BOX PUSH-UPS
69.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. \n\nBend your elbows and do a push-up. Return to the start position and repeat.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
This is a good exercise for your upper body.

70.name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT RIGHT
70.introduce: Lie down on your side with your head rested on your left arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.\n\nMake sure your right leg goes straight up and down during the exercise. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

76.name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT RIGHT
76.introduce: Lie on your right side with head resting on your right hand. \n\nThen put your left foot forward on the floor. Lift your right leg up and down.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.
It works if you feel your bottom inner thigh burning.
This exercise is good for your inner thighs.

78.name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT LEFT
78.introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left hand. \n\nThen put your right foot forward on the floor. Lift your left leg up and down.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.
It works if you feel your bottom inner thigh burning.
This exercise is good for your inner thighs.

80.name: SIDE LEG CIRCLES LEFT
80.introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right hand. \n\nThen lift your left leg and rotate your foot in circles.

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Make sure your body stays straight.
Your lifted leg should be directly over your body.
Breathe regularly.
To get more of a challenge, don't support yourself with your upper hand on the floor.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise works on your legs and lower abdominals.

81.name: SCISSORS
81.introduce:
Lie on your back with arms at sides, palms down and legs extended. 

Lift your legs and cross the right thigh over the left, then reverse the exercise. 

Make sure your back is always flat.

It's a great exercise for the obliques and rectus abdominis.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Slightly bend your knees.
Breathe naturally.
To make it easier, place your hands under your glutes to get more balance.
This exercise primarily targets your lower abs.
This exercise can help you get great balance.

82.name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT LEFT
82.introduce:
Lie down on your side with your head rested on your right arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.

Make sure your left leg goes straight up and down during the exercise.

86.introduce:
Stand on the floor, bend your legs slightly and lean your upper body forward.

87.name: SIDE HOP
87.introduce: Stand on the floor, put your hands in front of you and hop from side to side.

88.name: BACKWARD LUNGE
88.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips. \n\nStep a big step backward with your right leg and lower your body until your left thigh is parallel to the floor. Return and repeat with the other side.

89.name: SUPERMAN
89.introduce: Lie on your stomach with your arms extended straight overhead. Then raise both your arms and legs up off the floor. \n\nHold this position for two seconds. Return to the start position and repeat.

91.name: GLUTE KICK BACK LEFT
91.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. \n\nThen kick one leg back until it is parallel with the ground. Switch to the other side after several sets.

92.name: GLUTE KICK BACK RIGHT

93.name: HIP BRIDGE & LEG LIFT LEFT

94.name: HIP BRIDGE & LEG LIFT RIGHT
94.introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Then lift one leg up while raising your hips off the floor as high as you can. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat with the other side.

98.name: CALF RAISES
98.introduce: Stand straight with feet together. Lift the heels, and stand on your tip toe. Then drop heels down. Repeat lifting the heels up and down for 10-15 times as a set.

120.name: INCHWORMS
120.introduce: Start with your feet shoulder width apart. \n\nBend your body and walk your hands in front of you as far as you can, then walk your hands back. Repeat the exercise.

Try to keep your legs straight.
Tighten your core.

Breathe naturally.

This exercise stretches your hamstrings.

121.name: TOY SOLDIERS
121.introduce: Start with your feet shoulder width apart. Keep your legs and arms straight. \n\nKick your left leg up to touch your right hand to your toes. Repeat with the other side.

Tighten your abs.
Don't lean your upper body forward.

124.name: CROSSOVER CRUNCH
124.introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your ears. \n\nRaise and twist your torso so your right elbow moves to meet your left knee. Repeat with the other side.

Exhale as you slowly raise your upper body, and inhale as you return to the start position.
Your neck shouldn't feel sore.

125.name: FLUTTER KICKS
125.introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nThen quickly raise your right leg up, and simultaneously lower your left leg. Switch legs and repeat.

127.name: HEEL TOUCH
127.introduce: Lie on the ground with your legs bent and your arms by your sides. \n\nSlightly lift your upper body off the floor and make your hands alternately reach your heels.

128.name: SIDE ARM RAISE
128.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

Raise your arms to the sides at shoulder height, then put them down. 

Repeat the exercise. Keep your arms straight during the exercise.

Pull your shoulders back.
Do not arch your back.
Exhale as you raise your arms, and inhale as you lower them.

129.name: ADDUCTOR STRETCH IN STANDING
129.introduce:
Stand with your feet wide distance apart and your hands rested on your hips. 

Then bend your left leg and lean your body to the left side. 

Hold the position for a few seconds, then return and repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Shift your weight away from the stretched leg until you feel the stretch in your inner thigh.
Squeeze the butt of the stretching side to increase the stretch.
Your feet should point straight forward.
Please don't rotate your feet out.
Exhale as you lower your body, and keep breathing normally as you hold the stretch.
You should feel stretch in the inner thigh of the stretching leg.

130.name: DYNAMIC CHEST
130.introduce: Stand on the floor with your feet shoulder width apart. Extend your arms forward at shoulder height with your palms facing each other. \n\nExtend your arms as far out as possible, then move them back to the front. Repeat the exercise.

Move your arms as far back as possible.
You can gradually increase the speed.
You can feel your chest and shoulders are stretching.
Inhale as you extend your arms out as far as possible, and exhale as you bring your arms back together in the front.
This exercise can stretch your chest and shoulders.

131.name: SHOULDER SHRUGS
131.introduce: Stand or sit on the floor. Raise your shoulders up towards your ears as far as you can, then drop them. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Raise your shoulders up as high as you can.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale as you raise your shoulders, and inhale as you drop them.
This exercise can loosen up your neck and upper back.

133.name: CROSS TOUCH AND REACH
133.introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended to your sides at the shoulder height. 

Then bend your body and use your left hand to touch your right foot or get as close as you can. Switch sides and repeat.

Exhale when you bend your body and inhale when you come up. 

Keep your back and legs straight during the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your back straight when bending your body.
Bend your body at 90 degrees.
Don't bend your knees.
Exhale as you bend down, and inhale as you come up.
When your arm is up in the air, you should feel stretch from your fingers to toes.
This exercise helps you warm up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings, torso and arms.

136.name: ARM CIRCLES COUNTERCLOCKWISE
136.introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height. 

Move your arms counterclockwise in circles fast.

Try to do it as fast as you can.

It's a great exercise for the deltoid muscle.

tips.text: Keep your arms straight.
Your arms should go from small circles to big circles.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.
This exercise targets your deltoids.
This exercise really helps loosen up your shoulders.
This is a great exercise to build arm muscle endurance.

140.name: BUTT KICKS
140.introduce: Stand up on the floor, then run in place while kicking your heel up to touch your butt with each step.\n\nTry to do it as fast as you can. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus and hamstrings.

tips.text: Please keep your chest up.
Please try to get your feet to touch your hips.
Please pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your abs.
Please land on your toes.
Please try to do it as fast as you can.
Try to maintain a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Always remember to inhale deeply through the nose and exhale fully through the mouth.
It’s a cardio exercise that can strengthen your gluteus and hamstrings.

141.name: CAT COW POSE
141.introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

144.name: CHILD'S POSE
144.introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.

If you find this difficult, try bringing your knees slightly apart; listen to your body and find what feels best.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

146.name: CRAB KICKS
146.introduce:
Sit on the floor with your legs bent together and your hands under your shoulders to support your body. 

Then lift one leg up while lifting your hips off the floor as high as you can. Switch to the other leg and repeat.

Push yourself up with your hips instead of your back. It's a great exercise for the gluteus.

tips.text: Please push yourself up with your hips instead of your back.
Please lift your hips off the floor as high as you can.
To make it more of a challenge, you can alternately kick your feet in the air.
Exhale as you lift your body up and kick your legs out.
Inhale as you bring your legs back in and lower your body.
This exercise works the back of your thighs, your shoulders, your abs, and especially your gluteus.

149.name: FORWARD BEND
149.introduce:
Stand on the floor with your feet together. 

Then bend your body and bring your upper body as close to your legs as you can. 

Hold this position for a few seconds and repeat.

Exhale when you bend your body and inhale when you come up. Keep your legs straight during the exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your legs straight.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
Breathe regularly.

154.name: QUAD STRETCH
154.introduce:
Stand on the floor, then bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. 

Hold this position for a few seconds, then change sides and repeat.

Your lifted knee should always go straight down, and your upper body should keep straight during the exercise.

The knee of your lifted leg should always point straight toward the ground.
Please keep your upper body straight.
Exhale as you lift one foot up behind you and bring it towards your buttocks.
Inhale as you lower your foot back down to the ground.
This exercise works on your quadriceps.

155.name: SHOULDER STRETCH
155.introduce: Place one arm across your body, parallel to the ground, then use the other arm to pull the parallel arm toward your chest. \n\nHold for a while, switch arms and repeat the exercise. Keep the inside arm straight during the exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

163.name: TORSO TWIST
163.introduce: Stand on the floor with feet shoulder width apart, then rotate your body gently and slowly. This stretches your back and hips.\n\nRelax your shoulders. Your toes should always face forward.

tips.text: Please rotate your body gently and slowly.
Your toes should always face forward.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
Please relax your shoulders.
Please don\'t twist your legs.
Exhale deeply as you twist to the side.
Inhale as you twist back to the center.
This exercise stretches your back and hips.

164.name: UP AND DOWN PLANK
164.introduce:
Start in the straight arm plank position. 

Then bend your right arm and place your forearm on the ground with your elbow under your shoulder, then bend your left arm and come down into the traditional plank position. 

Then reverse and come back to the start position. Repeat the exercise.

Keep your body straight during the exercise. Inhale when you come down and exhale when you come up.

It's a great exercise for the quadriceps, triceps and abdominal muscles.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your legs extended straight.
Please keep your head, neck and spine aligned.
Please don\'t sink or raise your hips.
Inhale deeply as you lower your body to help you lower further.
Exhale as you raise your body to help you keep stable.
This exercise strengthens and tones your core, arms, glutes, wrists and shoulders.

167.name: STANDING BICYCLE CRUNCHES
167.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Bring your knee to your opposite elbow. \n\nReturn to the start position and repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
You can feel your entire core squeezing.
Exhale when lift your knees and inhale when lower them.
This exercise works on your entire core.

168.name: SWIMMER AND SUPERMAN
168.introduce: Lie on your stomach with your arms extended straight overhead.\n\nAlternately lift your opposite arm and leg.

tips.text: You should do it on a mat.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
If you feel it's too easy, raise both your legs and arms at the same time.
This exercise will engage your abs.
This exercise will strengthen your butt and lower back.

169.name: CLAPPING CRUNCHES
169.introduce: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet lifted a little bit and back tilted backwards. Alternately lift your legs and clap under your knees.

tips.text: We suggest that you do this on a mat.
Look straight ahead.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when you lift your knees, and inhale when you lower them.
To get more of a challenge, keep your leg straight.
If you feel it's too hard, put your feet on the floor.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your abdominal muscles.

170.name: CLAPS OVER HEAD
170.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Raise your arms and clap over your head.

tips.text: Keep your arms straight during the exercise.
Exhale as you raise your arms, and inhale as you lower them.
This exercise can warm up your shoulders.
This exercise targets your deltoids.

171.name: SKI SQUAT & LEG LIFT
171.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. 

Do a squat, and when you come up, lift one of your legs backward and raise your hands above your head. 

Repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Please keep your back flat.
Please do it slowly so you feel the squeezing.
When you squat down, your knees should not go over your toes.
Please don’t lean forward when lifting your leg.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
If you feel it's too hard, please hold a chair to keep balance.
This exercise helps tone your glutes.

175.name: BENT LEG TWIST
175.introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees up at a 90 degree angle. 

Extend your arms to the sides and put your palms down on the ground. 

Twist your legs to the left while keeping your upper body in place and your knees and feet together. 

Hold it for one second, then return and twist to the other side. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please do it slowly to get better results.
Please make sure your knees and feet are together.
Please tighten your abs during the entire exercise.
Please keep your knees at a 90 degree angle.
Please don\'t rotate your legs to the point where your opposite arm can no longer stay on the floor.
Exhale as you twist your knees to one side.
Inhale as you bring your knees back to center.
This exercise targets your core muscles.

177.name: DEAD BUG
177.introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees up at a 90 degree angle and your arms lifted towards the ceiling. 

Lower your right leg, and extend your left arm above your head. 

Hold it for one second, then return to the start position and repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please always keep your lower back pressed against the floor.
Please don\'t arch your back.
Too hard? Just extend your arms or legs.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale when lifting your arm and opposite leg, and exhale when lowering them.

178.name: RECLINED OBLIQUE TWIST
178.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and your elbows directly under your shoulders.

 Lift your left leg up at a 45 degree angle while reaching your right arm over to your left side.

 Then slowly go back to the starting position. Repeat several times, and then switch to the other side.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do this slowly to get better results.
Please keep your legs straight.
If you feel the exercise is too hard, you can put your legs on the floor.
If you feel the exercise is too easy, you can lift both legs.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise tones your obliques, abs and thighs.

185.name: RHOMBOID PULLS
185.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

Raise your arms parallel to the ground, and bend your elbows. Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please squeeze your shoulder blades when pulling your elbows back.
Please keep your triceps contracted.
Exhale when pulling your elbows back, and inhale when going back to the start position.
Too easy? You can hold dumbbells in your hands.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders and upper back muscles.

187.name: TRICEPS KICKBACKS
187.introduce:
Lean forward, bend your knees and your elbows.

Extend your arms behind you and squeeze your triceps. Please make your arms parallel to the ground when extending them.

Go back to the start position, and repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your neck and spine in line.
Please fully extend your arms when kicking them back.
Please squeeze your triceps when kicking your arms back.
Please don\'t move your upper arm.
Exhale when extending your arms, and inhale when bringing them back.
If you feel it’s too easy, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
It’s an excellent exercise for the triceps muscles.

191.name: REVERSE SNOW ANGELS
191.introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your arms at your sides.

Lift your arms up and extend them over your head to touch your thumbs. Then slowly bring them back.

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do it slowly to get a better result.
Please don’t let your arms touch the ground during the exercise.
To get more of a challenge, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
To get more of a challenge, you can lift your feet up off the floor.
Inhale slowly as you draw your arms overhead.
Exhale as you draw your arms back to your sides.
This exercise can help build your endurance.
This exercise strengthens the muscles of your scapular region.

192.name: ARM SCISSORS
192.introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart.

Stretch your arms in front of you at shoulder height with one arm overlap the other in the shape of the letter “X”, and then spread them apart.

Switch arms, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please always keep your arms at shoulder height.
If it\'s too easy for you, you can hold dumbbells in your hands.
Exhale as you bring your arms together in a scissoring motion.
Inhale as you open your arms back to the start position.

193.name: FLOOR Y RAISES
193.introduce: Lie face down on the floor with your arms fully extended and your thumbs pointing up, your body should be in the shape of the letter “Y”.\n\nRaise your arms off the ground as far as you can and pause them at the top for 2 seconds. Slowly go back to the start position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your arms straight during the exercise.
Tighten your abdominals.
Pause your arms at the top, then slowly drop them down.
Exhale when lifting your arms, and inhale when dropping them down.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders and upper back.

194.name: V-UP
194.introduce: Lie on your back with your arms and legs extended and your legs squeezed together.\n\nRaise your upper body and legs, use your arms to touch your toes, then go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your legs straight and your feet together.
Exhale when raising your upper body and legs, and inhale when putting them down.
If you feel it is too easy, you can hold weights in your hands.
If you feel it is too hard, touch your knees instead of your toes.
It works on your abs and back.

195.name: HIP HINGE
195.introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.

Sit your hips back and bend your upper body while keeping your upper body straight, then slowly go back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

Inhale as you bend down, and exhale as you come up.

tips.text: Please engage your core.
Please squeeze your glutes as you stand up.
You should feel stretching in your hamstrings as you bend down.
Push your hips back as you bend down.
Please keep your weight on your heels.
Inhale as you bend down, and exhale as you come up.

196.name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT
196.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your right leg and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Extend your right arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

197.name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT
197.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your left leg and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Extend your left arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

198.name: COBRA STRETCH
198.introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and feet close together. Place your hands beneath your shoulders, and bend your elbows close to your body.

Inhale deeply, press your palms into the floor, lifting your chest and shoulders off the ground. Keep your hips pressed firmly into the floor. 

Hold for a few breaths, raise and lower with your breath. On inhale, lift into spinal extension. On exhale, soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lift the chest. Exhale to soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

199.name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH LEFT
199.introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your left knee forward and drop your right knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
Inhale deeply as you lower your body into the lunge position.
Exhale as you press your hips forward and feel the stretch in your legs.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

200.name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH RIGHT
200.introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your right knee forward and drop your left knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
Inhale deeply as you lower your body into the lunge position.
Exhale as you press your hips forward and feel the stretch in your legs.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

201.name: CALF STRETCH LEFT
201.introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your right foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your left leg is fully extended and you can feel your left calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

202.name: CALF STRETCH RIGHT
202.introduce: Stand one big step away in front of a wall. Step forward with your left foot and push the wall with your hands. \n\nPlease make sure your right leg is fully extended and you can feel your right calf stretching. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your heels on the ground and toes pointing straight ahead.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please make sure your leg at the back is fully extended.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the calf of your extended leg.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise works on your calves, hamstrings and ankles.

203.name: TRICEPS STRETCH LEFT
203.introduce: Put your left hand on your back, use your right hand to grab your left elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your left shoulder down when pulling your left elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

204.name: TRICEPS STRETCH RIGHT
204.introduce: Put your right hand on your back, use your left hand to grab your right elbow and gently pull it. Hold this position for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please make sure that your elbow is bent to the max.
You should feel a stretch on your triceps.
Please press your right shoulder down when pulling your right elbow.
This workout stretches your triceps and helps improve your shoulder mobility.
Breathe regularly.

218.name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL
218.introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

219.name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL
219.introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even throughout the stretch.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

220.name: WALL CALF RAISES
220.introduce: Stand straight with your hands on the wall and feet shoulder width apart. \n\nLift your heels and stand on your toes. Then drop your heels down. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your body straight.
Always keep your core tight.
You should feel your calves burning.
Please raise your heels up as high as you can.
Exhale when lifting your heels and inhale when lowering them.
Please squeeze your calves when raising your heels up.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
This exercise works on your calves.

222.name: LYING BUTTERFLY STRETCH
222.introduce: Lie on the floor with your feet together. Bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together. Let your knees fall comfortably out to the sides, moving them toward the floor. \n\nPlace your hands by your sides or on your belly, and begin to breathe slowly and deeply through your nose. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to allow your knees to sink closer to the floor.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch in your groin.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your knees down.
Try to let your knees get closer and closer to the floor.

223.name: SUMO SQUAT
223.introduce:
Stand with your feet 1.5 times shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing outward. Place your hands by your sides.

Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. And bring your hands together in front of your chest.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your core tight.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hand.
This exercise targets all the muscles of your lower body.

224.name: CALF RAISE WITH SPLAYED FOOT
224.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Put your hands on the wall to maintain balance. \n\nTwist your ankles to make your toes point outwards, then lift your heels up and down.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please squeeze your calf muscles when raising your heels up.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
Inhale deeply as you lower your heels.
Exhale slowly as you raise your heels.
This exercise works your calf muscles.

228.name: HEELS TO THE HEAVENS
228.introduce: Lie on your back with your hands at your sides and legs straight up towards the ceiling. \n\nRaise your hips straight up off the floor, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please raise your hips as high as you can.
Please use your abs\' strength to raise your hips up.
Exhale as you raise up, and inhale as you lower down.
If it’s too easy for you, try not to rest your hips on the floor during the exercise.
Please keep your legs straight.
Please raise your hips straight up and down.
This exercise targets your lower abdominal muscles.

229.name: X MAN CRUNCH
229.introduce:
Lie on your back with your hands stretched at your sides and legs apart. 

Lift your legs and arms off the floor. Then raise your upper body and squeeze your arms and knees towards your abdominals. 

Lower your arms and legs (but don’t touch the floor) and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please contract your abs during the exercise.
Your neck shouldn\'t feel sore.
Exhale as you raise up, and inhale as you lower down.
Please use your abs\' strength to raise your body up off the floor.

230.name: SIDE CRUNCHES LEFT
230.introduce:
Lie on your right side with your right foot behind your left foot. 

Put your left hand behind your head and your right hand on the left side of your oblique muscles. 

Lift your right shoulder up off the floor. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please contract your obliques during each rep.
Please don’t tug your neck.
Your neck shouldn\'t feel sore.
Exhale as you raise up, and inhale as you lower down.
This exercise targets your oblique muscles.

231.name: SIDE CRUNCHES RIGHT
231.introduce:
Lie on your left side with your left foot behind your right foot. 

Put your right hand behind your head and your left hand on the right side of your oblique muscles. 

Lift your left shoulder up off the floor. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please contract your obliques during each rep.
Please don’t tug your neck.
Your neck shouldn\'t feel sore.
Exhale as you raise up, and inhale as you lower down.
This exercise targets your oblique muscles.

237.name: V-HOLD
237.introduce: Sit on the floor, lift your legs up at a 45 degree angle, and lean your upper body back at a 45 degree angle. Stretch your arms forward. Hold this position.\n\nDon't hold your breath. Breathe normally from your abdomen instead of your chest.

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Try to keep your legs as straight as you can.
Please don\'t arch your back.
Breathe regularly.
To make it easier, lower your feet on the floor.
This exercise targets the rectus abdominis and obliques.
This exercise enhances core strength.

238.name: STANDING SIDE BEND
238.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.

Rest one hand behind your head and the other at your side. Bend your torso towards the side where your extended arm is and reach that arm toward the floor.

Pause for one second and return to the starting position. Switch sides and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please pause for one second when your bend down.
Inhale when you bend down, and exhale when you go back to the starting position.
If it’s too easy for you, you can hold a dumbbell in the hand of your stretched arm.
This exercise works your obliques.

239.name: LYING TWIST STRETCH LEFT
239.introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the left, keeping shoulders grounded. 

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

240.name: LYING TWIST STRETCH RIGHT
240.introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the right, keeping shoulders grounded.

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

243.name: CROSS KNEE PLANK
243.introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring one knee and the opposite elbow in to touch each other, then bring them back. Repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please put your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Please keep your body straight.
Please make sure your abs are engaged.
Exhale as you bring your knee toward the opposite elbow, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
It works on your abs, obliques and hip flexors.

258.name: ARM CIRCLES CLOCKWISE
258.introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height. 

Move your arms clockwise in circles fast.

Try to do it as fast as you can.

It's a great exercise for the deltoid muscle.

tips.text: Keep your arms straight.
Your arms should go from small circles to big circles.
Breathe regularly.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in each hand.
This exercise targets your deltoids.
This exercise really helps loosen up your shoulders.
This is a great exercise to build arm muscle endurance.

259.name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT
259.introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your left knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your left knee towards your chest, keeping your right leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

260.name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT
260.introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your right knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your right knee towards your chest, keeping your left leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

261.name: STANDING GLUTE KICKBACKS LEFT
261.introduce: Stand straight with arms akimbo, then kick your left leg backwards and extend it as far as you can, meanwhile keep your legs and back straight and head up. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your leg straight when kicking it.
Keep your upper body still.
Don't lean your body forward.
Exhale when kicking your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankle.
If you feel it's too hard, hold a chair to keep balance.
You should feel your glutes engage.
This exercise can really tone your glutes.

262.name: STANDING GLUTE KICKBACKS RIGHT
262.introduce: Stand straight with arms akimbo, then kick your right leg backwards and extend it as far as you can, meanwhile keep your legs and back straight and head up. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your leg straight when kicking it.
Keep your upper body still.
Don't lean your body forward.
Exhale when kicking your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankle.
If you feel it's too hard, hold a chair to keep balance.
You should feel your glutes engage.
This exercise can really tone your glutes.

263.name: SHOULDER GATORS
263.introduce: Stand upright with your hands beside your ears and elbows facing each side. Rotate your elbows until both of them are facing the front.

tips.text: Please keep your back straight.
Do not raise or lower your elbows when rotating them.
Breathe regularly.

264.name: ALTERNATING HOOKS
264.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, and place your dominant foot slightly forward. Slightly bend your knees, clench your fists and bend your elbows at 90 degrees. \n\nRaise your right arm to shoulder height and keep your forearm parallel to the ground. Rotate your shoulders and hips and punch towards the left. Switch sides and repeat.

tips.text: Keep your elbows at 90 degrees.
Rotate your shoulders and hips.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Breathe in through the nose and out through the mouth.
Take quick and short breaths to maintain oxygen flow to the muscles.
Always keep your core engaged.

268.name: STANDING BICEPS STRETCH LEFT
268.introduce: Stand with your left arm close to a wall. Extend your left arm and put your left hand on the wall, then gently turn your body to the right.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Breathe naturally.

269.name: STANDING BICEPS STRETCH RIGHT
269.introduce: Stand with your right arm close to a wall. Extend your right arm and put your right hand on the wall, then gently turn your body to the left.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Breathe naturally.

275.name: SKIPPING WITHOUT ROPE
275.introduce: Place your arms at your sides and pretend to hold a skipping rope handle in each hand. \n\nJump and alternately land on the balls of your feet, rotating your wrists at the same time as if you were spinning a rope.

tips.text: Your heels should not touch the ground during skipping.
Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth at a regular pace.
This is a good exercise for your cardiovascular system.
It\'s a full-body workout that tones the muscle of your lower and upper body.

276.name: FROG PRESS
276.introduce: Lie on your back with your legs lifted, knees bent and heels squeezed together. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nStraighten your legs and bring them back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please do it slowly to get better results.
Your lower back shouldn’t feel strained.
Exhale when straightening your legs, and inhale when bringing them back.
This exercise really tightens your inner thighs.

278.name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT
278.introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

279.name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT
279.introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

280.name: BENCH GLUTE KICK BACK RIGHT
280.introduce: Start with your left knee and your hands on a bench, put your hands directly under your shoulders. \n\nThen kick your right leg back until it is parallel with the ground. Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a bench.
Your toes should point toward the floor.
Keep your right leg straight.
Your hands should be directly under your shoulders.
Keep your back flat.
Put your weight on your wrists.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
You shouldn't feel any strain in your back.
This exercise is going to give you a sexy butt.

281.name: BENCH GLUTE KICK BACK LEFT
281.introduce: Start with your right knee and your hands on a bench, put your hands directly under your shoulders. \n\nThen kick your left leg back until it is parallel with the ground. Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a bench.
Your toes should point toward the floor.
Keep your left leg straight.
Your hands should be directly under your shoulders.
Keep your back flat.
Put your weight on your wrists.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
You shouldn't feel any strain in your back.
This exercise is going to give you a sexy butt.

282.name: MODIFIED BURPEES
282.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward, then bring your feet back and jump up. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Put your hands between your knees.
Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back and shoulders.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
It's a great exercise that we highly recommend to you.

287.name: ELBOWS BACK
287.introduce: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart. Place your hands on both sides of your waist, fingers facing downwards and elbows facing outwards.\n\nGently pull your elbows backward, then bring them back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Exhale as you bring your elbows backwards.
Inhale as you release your arms back to the starting position.
It is a good stretching exercise for your shoulders and chest.

288.name: STAR CRAWL
288.introduce:
Start on all fours, with your hands directly under your shoulders, and knees under your hips. 

Move your left hand forward, and bring your right knee to your right elbow. Switch sides and do it again. 

Then move backward in a reverse way and return to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Your knee should touch your elbow when moving forward and backward.
Inhale and exhale in a steady rhythm throughout the exercise.
It is a good exercise for your core, legs, and upper body.

289.name: UP & DOWN NODS
289.introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, gently bring your chin down to your chest.\n\nInhale, slowly look up towards the ceiling. Repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please don't turn your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Exhale as you bend forward, and inhale as you extend back.

290.name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TURNS
290.introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, gently turn your head to the left.\n\nInhale, return to center. Switch sides and repeat.

tips.text: Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Exhale as you turn to each side, and inhale as you return to center.

291.name: SIDE-TO-SIDE TILTS
291.introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, gently tilt your head towards your left shoulder.\n\nInhale, return to center. Switch sides and repeat.

tips.text: Please don't move your shoulders when tilting your head.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch.
Exhale as you tilt to each side, and inhale as you return to center.

292.name: SIDE NECK STRETCH LEFT
292.introduce:
Place your right hand on the left side of your head.

Exhale, gently pull your head towards the right.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing naturally.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please always keep your left shoulder flat.
Please pull your head gently.
Breathe regularly.

293.name: SIDE NECK STRETCH RIGHT
293.introduce:
Place your left hand on the right side of your head.

Exhale, gently pull your head towards the left.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing naturally.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please always keep your right shoulder flat.
Please pull your head gently.
Breathe regularly.

294.name: LEVATOR SCAPULAE STRETCH LEFT
294.introduce: Rotate your head diagonally toward the right. Place your right hand on the back left side of your head.\n\nExhale, gently pull your head toward the right front side. Hold for a few seconds, breathing naturally.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your upper body straight.
Please pull your head gently.
Breathe regularly.

295.name: LEVATOR SCAPULAE STRETCH RIGHT
295.introduce: Rotate your head diagonally toward the left. Place your left hand on the back right side of your head.\n\nExhale, gently pull your head toward the left front side. Hold for a few seconds, breathing naturally.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your upper body straight.
Please pull your head gently.
Breathe regularly.

296.name: CLOCKWISE SHOULDER ROLLS
296.introduce: Sit upright. Inhale, roll your shoulders up towards your ears. Exhale, roll them back and down. Repeat.

tips.text: Please just move your shoulders, and keep your neck relaxed.
Inhale as your shoulders roll up, and exhale as they roll back and down.

297.name: COUNTERCLOCKWISE SHOULDER ROLLS
297.introduce: Sit upright. Inhale, roll your shoulders back and up toward your ears. Exhale, roll them forward and down. Repeat.

tips.text: Please just move your shoulders, and keep your neck relaxed.
Inhale as your shoulders roll back and up, and exhale as they roll forward and down.

298.name: OVERHEAD ARM CLOCKWISE CIRCLES
298.introduce: Hold your hands together and lift them overhead. Then move your arms clockwise in big circles.

tips.text: Please focus the movement on your middle and upper back.
Please lift your hands up as much as possible.
Breathe regularly.

299.name: OVERHEAD ARM COUNTERCLOCKWISE CIRCLES
299.introduce: Hold your hands together and lift them overhead. Then move your arms counterclockwise in big circles.

tips.text: Please focus the movement on your middle and upper back.
Please lift your hands up as much as possible.
Breathe regularly.

300.name: CLASP HANDS BEHIND BACK
300.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. \n\nPut your hands behind you and interlock them. Then pull your elbows back and extend your arms. Hold it for a few seconds.

tips.text: Please always keep your upper body straight.
This exercise helps to relieve neck tension and pain.
Breathe regularly.

301.name: FLOOR SLIDES
301.introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. 

Put your arms straight over your head. 

Slide your forearms down at 90 degree angles, then slide them up. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your elbows and wrists always on the floor.
Slide your arms up as high as possible without letting your lower back off the floor.
Take a deep breath in as you slide your arms up towards your head.
Exhale slowly as you slide your arms back down towards your sides.

302.name: SHOULDER OUTWARD ROTATION
302.introduce: Bend your elbows at 90 degrees. Turn your palms up, clench your fists with your thumbs pointed outward.\n\nExhale, rotate your forearms outward horizontally. Inhale as you return to the starting position. Repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale when rotating your forearms outward, and inhale when bringing them back.
Please squeeze your shoulder blades when rotating outward.
Please always keep your shoulders flat.

303.name: LYING SWING LEGS LEFT
303.introduce: Lie on your back with your toes towards the ceiling, legs flat on the floor and arms straight overhead. \n\nSwing your legs to your right and hold this position.

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

304.name: LYING SWING LEGS RIGHT
304.introduce: Lie on your back with your toes towards the ceiling, legs flat on the floor and arms straight overhead. \n\nSwing your legs to your left and hold this position.

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

305.name: SEATED SIDE BEND RIGHT
305.introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your left arm overhead, and put your right hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the right, gently bending your right arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your left rib cage to help deepen the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

306.name: SEATED SIDE BEND LEFT
306.introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. 

Inhale, lift your right arm overhead, and put your left hand on the floor for support. Exhale slowly, bend your upper body to the left, gently bending your left arm. 

Hold the side bend. Breathe deeply into your right rib cage to help deepen the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
