You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Inhale to expand through the ribs, exhale to deepen the side stretch.

307.name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST RIGHT
307.introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your left hand on your right knee and your right hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the right. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your left arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

308.name: SEATED SPINAL TWIST LEFT
308.introduce:
Sit and cross your legs on the mat. Put your right hand on your left knee and your left hand behind you on the floor. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and lift your chest. Exhale and twist your upper body to the left. 

Hold this position, allowing your spine to lengthen with each inhale and deepen the twist with each exhale.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your weight on your hips; don’t shift it to your right arm.
Please don’t let your hips off the floor.
Please don’t tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the twist.

322.name: PLANK JACKS
322.introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position with your hands under your shoulders and feet together.\n\nHop your feet apart and land on your toes, then hop back. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper body stable.
Your body should be in a straight line.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
Exhale through your mouth as you jump your feet out.
Inhale through your nose as you jump your feet back in.
It is a good exercise for your abs, core, shoulders, and lower back.

325.name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST
325.introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

326.name: WRISTS & ANKLES STRETCH LEFT
326.introduce: Clasp your hands together, and lift your left heel up. Alternately roll your left and right wrists forward; meanwhile, roll your left ankle clockwise.\n\nDo it for several times. Change directions for both hands and legs and repeat.

tips.text: Breathe naturally.

327.name: WRISTS & ANKLES STRETCH RIGHT
327.introduce: Clasp your hands together, and lift your right heel up. Alternately roll your left and right wrists forward; meanwhile, roll your right ankle clockwise.\n\nDo it several times. Change directions for both hands and leg and repeat.

tips.text: Breathe naturally.

328.name: KNEE CIRCLE
328.introduce: Stand with your feet together and knees bent. Put your hands on your knees, and move your knees in clockwise circles several times. Change directions and repeat.

tips.text: Breathe naturally.

329.name: STANDING KNEE TO CHEST
329.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, chest up and shoulders back. Exhale, lift one knee up, and grab it with both hands.\n\nThen gently pull it towards your body as much as you can. Breathe naturally. Hold for a few seconds, switch sides and repeat.

tips.text: Please keep your body straight when lifting your knee up.
Breathe regularly.

330.name: GLUTE STRETCH LEFT
330.introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right knee, and grab the back of your right thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

331.name: GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT
331.introduce:
Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left knee, and grab the back of your left thigh with both hands. Gently pull it towards your body.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, soften your hips, deepening the stretch.

tips.text: Please relax your hips.
If it’s hard for you, pull your thigh up by holding a towel.
To make a deeper stretch, use one of your hands to push your opposite knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

332.name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT
332.introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your right leg in and extend your left leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your left foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your left hamstring.

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your left thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

333.name: SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT
333.introduce:
Sit cross-legged with your left leg in and extend your right leg in front of you.

Inhale, then exhale as you fold your upper body forward. Try to grasp your right foot with both hands.

Hold this position. Inhale to grow taller through your spine, exhale to relax your shoulders and deepen the stretch along your right hamstring.

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the back of your right thigh.
Please keep your back straight.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

334.name: SEATED BUTTERFLY STRETCH
334.introduce: Sit on the floor with your feet together, and grab your toes.\n\nOpen your knees to the sides, and press your knees down as much as possible.

tips.text: Press your knees down as much as possible.
Please keep your back straight.
Breathe regularly.

335.name: "AEIOU"
335.introduce: Open your mouth as wide as you can, and say the English vowels \"A\", \"E\", \"I\", \"O\", \"U\" in succession. Repeat this several times.

tips.text: Take slow, deep breaths throughout the exercise to promote relaxation.
It helps slim your cheeks and get rid of your double chin.

336.name: NECK LIFT
336.introduce: Raise your head to look at the ceiling. Stretch your lower jaw forward, and hold this position for several seconds, then release. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: You should feel the neck skin under your chin stretching.
Exhale as you raise your head and stretch your lower jaw forward.
Inhale again as you lower your head back down.
This exercise tightens the neck muscles and reduces neck lines.

benefit.text: Help get rid of double chin

337.name: UNDERCHIN DUCK
337.introduce:
Raise your head to look at the ceiling. 

Purse your lips just like blowing a kiss to the ceiling, hold it for a few seconds, then stretch your mouth into a smile.

Return to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: You should feel the tension in your neck.
Exhale as you raise your head and pucker your lips.
Inhale again as you lower your head back down
This exercise helps tighten your neck muscles.
It\'s a good exercise to help you get rid of your double chin.

338.name: NOSE TOUCHING
338.introduce: Open your mouth, stick out your tongue as far as you can, and try to touch your nose with the tip of your tongue.\n\nHold this position for several seconds and release. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your lips relaxed.
Maintain steady and regular breathing through your nose.
Do not hold your breath.
Please don\'t touch your upper lip while trying to reach your nose.

benefit.text: Help get rid of double chin

339.name: DRAWN CHEEKS
339.introduce: Turn your head to the left side and pull your lower jaw forward to stretch your neck muscles. \n\nThen switch sides and do it again. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Exhale as you turn your head to one side.
Inhale as you turn the head to the neutral position.
You should feel your neck muscles stretching.

340.name: LION
340.introduce:
Close your mouth, close your eyes and take a deep breath. 

Then exhale with a "ha" sound, tongue stretched out and eyes looking up. 

Go back to the starting position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Inhale deeply through the nose, filling up the lungs with air.
Exhale forcefully through the mouth while making a "ha" sound.
This exercise helps to firm up your neck muscles.
It is a good exercise to release the tension in your chest and face.

benefit.text: Relieves tension in the chest and face

341.name: CLOCKWISE CIRCLES
341.introduce: Close your mouth, purse your lips and move your mouth clockwise in circles.

342.name: COUNTERCLOCKWISE CIRCLES
342.introduce: Close your mouth, purse your lips and move your mouth counterclockwise in circles.

343.name: CHEEK FIRMER
343.introduce: Close and purse your mouth, then move it from one side to the other.

tips.text: You should feel tension on the muscles around your mouth.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even.
This exercise helps reduce cheek fat.

benefit.text: Help get rid of chubby cheeks

346.name: JAW LINE
346.introduce: Start with your mouth slightly opened. Move your chin from one side to the other.

benefit.text: Help get rid of double chin

347.name: EYE LIFT
347.introduce: Put fingertips of your right hand on the outer corner of your left eye, then gently pull your head to the right. Return to the starting position, change side and repeat it.

348.name: SMILING FISH FACE
348.introduce: Close your mouth and suck your cheeks in, then try to smile but hold this position.

tips.text: Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even.
This exercise really tones your cheeks.

benefit.text: Help get rid of chubby cheeks

349.name: SMILE
349.introduce:
Close your mouth and clench your teeth. 

Push the roof of your mouth with your tongue, then stretch the corner of your mouth as much as you can. 

Hold it for a few seconds, relax and repeat.

tips.text: Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even.
You can feel strong tension in your chin muscle.

benefit.text: Help get rid of double chin

350.name: PUFFY CHEEKS
350.introduce:
Close your mouth and puff your cheek with air. 

Use your hands to press on your cheeks. 

Hold it for a few seconds, relax and repeat.

benefit.text: Help get rid of chubby cheeks

351.name: MARILYN
351.introduce: Start with your mouth closed. Purse your lips and blow a kiss. Hold it for a few seconds, relax and repeat.

tips.text: Take deep breaths in through the nose.
Exhale slowly through the mouth.
This exercise helps tighten the muscles around your mouth.

benefit.text: Help get rid of chubby cheeks

352.name: LIPS DOWN PULL
352.introduce: Start with your mouth closed. Pull the corners of your mouth down. Return to the starting position and repeat it.

tips.text: Please look straight ahead during the exercise.
Focus on your breath and keep it steady and even.
You should feel strong tension in your chin muscles.

benefit.text: Help get rid of double chin

353.name: EYES CIRCLES
353.introduce: Start with your eyes open. Slowly rotate your eyes clockwise. Change direction after a few circles.

354.name: SQUAT REACH UPS
354.introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder width apart, elbows bent, palms facing each other and fingers pointed toward the ceiling. 

Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. When you come up, turn your body to the left, straighten your right leg, lift your right heel and stretch and reach your right arm to the left. 

Return to the start position, and repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.

355.name: PRONE FLUTTER KICKS
355.introduce: Lie on your stomach with your legs extended and your chin on your arms. \n\nLift your legs off the floor, then alternately lift your left and right legs.

tips.text: Please do this exercise on a mat.
Tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Try to keep your legs off the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
This exercise focuses on the glutes, adductor and hamstring muscles.

356.name: STRAIGHT LEG FIRE HYDRANT LEFT
356.introduce: Start with your hands under your shoulders, your right knee directly under your butt and your left leg stretched and rested on the ground. \n\nLift your left leg to your left side. Return to the start position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Always keep your core tight.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
Please do it slowly to feel your muscle burning.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.

357.name: STRAIGHT LEG FIRE HYDRANT RIGHT
357.introduce: Start with your hands under your shoulders, your left knee directly under your butt and your right leg stretched and rested on the ground. \n\nLift your right leg to your right side. Return to the start position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Always keep your core tight.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
Please do it slowly to feel your muscle burning.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.

363.name: KNEE TO ELBOW CRUNCHES
363.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands behind your ears. \n\nRaise your right knee, and use your left elbow to touch your right knee. Change sides and repeat.

tips.text: Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
You can feel your entire core squeezing.
Exhale when lift your knees and inhale when lower them.
This exercise works on your entire core.

364.name: FLUTTER KICK SQUATS
364.introduce:
Start in the classic squat position. 

Jump up, putting one foot forward and the other foot backward, then jump and switch legs. 

Jump again to come back to the squat position, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your core tight.
Push the toes of your back foot to jump, and gently land on the heel of your front foot.
Inhale through your nose and exhale through the mouth.
Breathe in a regular pattern according to your cadance.
This exercise works your quadriceps, glutes and hamstrings.
This exercise not only strengthens your lower body but also burns lots of calories in a short time.

369.name: BACK BOW PULLS
369.introduce: Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and your arms raised and extended overhead. \n\nBend your elbows and pull them down to your sides. Return to the starting position and repeat.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Try not to let your arms touch the floor.
Please keep your neck in line with your spine.
Inhale deeply as you extend your arms overhead.
Exhale as you bend your elbows and pull them down to your sides.

377.name: CRUNCH KICKS
377.introduce:
Lie on your back with your arms at your sides and shoulders slightly lifted. 

Raise your legs off the floor, bend your knees and pull them toward your chest. 

Kick your feet forward and repeat it.

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Please always keep your lower back on the ground.
You should feel your core engaged.
Exhale deeply as you bring your knees close to your chest.
Inhale as you kick your legs up towards the ceiling.

378.name: PLANK HIP DIPS
378.introduce:
Start in a standard plank position. 

Twist your spine to your left side until your left leg touches the floor, then twist to the other side. 

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please don't sink or raise your hips.
If you feel it's too hard, you can twist without letting your legs touch the floor.
Take deep and steady breaths.

379.name: SQUAT PULSES
379.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Bend your arms in front of you to keep balance. \n\nLower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. Come half way up instead of coming all the way up, then squat down again. Repeat.

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale through your nose and exhale through the mouth.
Breathe in a regular pattern according to your cadence.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your glutes really on fire.
Please keep your back straight.

380.name: GLUTE KICKBACK CROSSOVER WITH LEFT LEG
380.introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Lift your left leg backward, then lower it to your right side. Lift it again and lower it straight down. 

Please don’t let your left foot touch the floor. Repeat the steps.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Your right knee should be directly under your butt.
Please squeeze your butt at the top.
Please keep your left leg straight.
Please keep your back straight.
Breathe regularly.

381.name: GLUTE KICKBACK CROSSOVER WITH RIGHT LEG
381.introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Lift your right leg backward, then lower it to your left side. Lift it again and lower it straight down. 

Please don’t let your right foot touch the floor. Repeat the steps.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Your left knee should be directly under your butt.
Please squeeze your butt at the top.
Please keep your right leg straight.
Please keep your back straight.
Breathe regularly.

387.name: WALL STANDING GLUTE KICKBACKS LEFT
387.introduce: Stand straight with your arms on a wall, then kick your left leg backwards and extend it as far as you can, meanwhile keep your legs and back straight and head up. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your leg straight when kicking it.
Keep your upper body still.
Don't lean your body forward.
Exhale when kicking your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankle.
You should feel your glutes engage.
This exercise can really tone your glutes.

388.name: WALL STANDING GLUTE KICKBACKS RIGHT
388.introduce: Stand straight with your arms on a wall, then kick your right leg backwards and extend it as far as you can, meanwhile keep your legs and back straight and head up. \n\nGo back to the start position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your leg straight when kicking it.
Keep your upper body still.
Don't lean your body forward.
Exhale when kicking your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankle.
You should feel your glutes engage.
This exercise can really tone your glutes.

398.name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT
398.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your left leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with both hands. 

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, release tension in your hamstring and deepen the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.

399.name: SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT
399.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Inhale, then exhale as you lift your right leg toward the ceiling. Hold the back of your thigh with both hands. 

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine; with each exhale, release tension in your hamstring and deepen the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.

401.name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG
401.introduce:
Start on all fours in a tabletop position, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Exhale, press through your palms and the balls of your feet, straighten your legs, and lift your hips into an inverted 'V' shape, lengthening your spine as much as possible. Gently draw your heels toward the floor.

Hold this position while breathing steadily, and relax into the stretch with each breath.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it\'s too hard for you, please bend your knees slightly.
Please keep your back straight.
Please sink your shoulders.
Please keep your arms tight.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

402.name: PIGEON POSE LEFT
402.introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, bring your left knee forward, and place your left knee behind your left wrist on the ground. Exhale, slide your right leg back, extending it straight behind you.

Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg. 

Hold for a few seconds. Inhale to lengthen your spine forward. Exhale, release tension in your left hip.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your left hip to open.

403.name: PIGEON POSE RIGHT
403.introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

Inhale, bring your right knee forward, and place your right knee behind your right wrist on the ground. Exhale, slide your left leg back, extending it straight behind you.

Put your forearms on the ground in front of your leg. 

Hold for a few seconds. Inhale to lengthen your spine forward. Exhale, release tension in your right hip.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Your front knee should be in line with the outside of your shoulder.
You should not feel any discomfort.
This exercise helps to make your muscle groups more flexible.
This exercise helps to reduce sciatic pain.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to soften your right hip to open.

410.name: CROSS TOUCH AND REACH
410.introduce:
Stand on the floor with your arms extended to your sides at the shoulder height. 

Then bend your body and use your left hand to touch your right foot or get as close as you can. Switch sides and repeat.

Exhale when you bend your body and inhale when you come up. 

Keep your back and legs straight during the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your back straight when bending your body.
Bend your body at 90 degrees.
Don't bend your knees.
Exhale as you bend down, and inhale as you come up.
When your arm is up in the air, you should feel stretch from your fingers to toes.
This exercise helps you warm up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings, torso and arms.

415.name: QUARTER WALL SQUAT
415.introduce: Stand in front of a wall with your feet apart a little wider than shoulder-width, and your hips against the wall. \n\nBend your knees to make a 1/4 squat and then return to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Take a deep breath in as you're standing straight.
Exhale slowly when lowering yourself to engage your core.
Please keep your knees in line with your tiptoes.

416.name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION LEFT
416.introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly extend your left leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground.\n\nInhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

417.name: OPEN CHAIN KNEE EXTENSION RIGHT
417.introduce: Sit upright. Exhale, slowly extend your right leg until it is straight and parallel to the ground.\n\nInhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your back straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Do this exercise slowly and don't use the impulsive force.
Don't lean forward or backward during the exercise.

428.name: SPIDERMAN PLANK
428.introduce: Lie on the floor with your toes and forearms on the ground. Keep your body straight. \n\nBend your left knee and bring it to the outside of your left arm. Return to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Make sure your body is straight.
Tighten your abdominals.
Please don’t sink or raise your hips.
Try to bring your lifted knee to the outside of your arm as close as you can.
This exercise strengthens your core and shoulders.
Exhale when bending your knee, and inhale when returning to plank position.

430.name: DOWNWARD FACING DOG ON THE WALL
430.introduce: Stand in front of a wall with your hands against the wall. Slowly step back and slide your hands down until your upper body is parallel to the floor. \n\nPush your hands forward into the wall as you pull your hips away from the wall. Transfer your weight into your feet. Hold this position.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please put your feet under your hips to feel more stretch.
Take deep and steady breaths.
This exercise can elongate your spine and stretch your shoulders and legs.

445.name: OBLIQUE CROSSOVER CRUNCH LEFT
445.introduce: Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your left ankle on your right knee, right hand behind your ear and left arm extend to the side on the floor. \n\nLift your shoulders off the floor, bring your right elbow to meet your left knee, and left arm close to your body, then slowly return. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please perform it on mat.
Please do it slowly to feel the squeeze in your core.
Exhale when lifting your shoulders, and inhale when lowering them.
This exercise works your obliques.

446.name: OBLIQUE CROSSOVER CRUNCH RIGHT
446.introduce: Lie on your back with your feet flat on the floor. Put your right ankle on your left knee, left hand behind your ear and right arm extend to the side on the floor. \n\nLift your shoulders off the floor, bring your left elbow to meet your right knee, and right arm close to your body, then slowly return. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please perform it on mat.
Please do it slowly to feel the squeeze in your core.
Exhale when lifting your shoulders, and inhale when lowering them.
This exercise works your obliques.

453.name: STRAIGHT ARM KNEE PLANK
453.introduce: Perform the straight arm plank position, but with your knees on the ground. Keep your arms straight and your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.\n\nMaintain slow, even, and deep breaths throughout—avoid holding your breath to help improve stability. Hold this position.

tips.text: Inhale to lengthen the spine, exhale to engage your core.
Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Please tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
If you feel it's too easy, you can straighten your legs.
Please put your hands directly under your shoulders.

468.name: KNEELING SIDE PLANK LEFT
468.introduce: Lie on your left side with your forearm supporting your body and knees bent on the floor. \n\nKeep your spine straight. Hold this position.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Please tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
If you feel it's too easy, you can straighten your legs.

469.name: KNEELING SIDE PLANK RIGHT
469.introduce: Lie on your right side with your forearm supporting your body and knees bent on the floor. \n\nKeep your spine straight. Hold this position.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your body straight.
Please tighten your core.
Breathe naturally.
Please put your elbow directly under your shoulder.
If you feel it's too easy, you can straighten your legs.

477.name: RIGHT LEG LATERAL RAISE
477.introduce:
Hold the chair back with your left hand for balance.

Exhale, slowly lift your right leg out to the right side as high as possible.

Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your core.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Please keep your upper body still.
This exercise works the lateral muscles on your legs.

478.name: LEFT LEG LATERAL RAISE
478.introduce:
Hold the chair back with your right hand for balance.

Exhale, slowly lift your left leg out to the left side as high as possible.

Inhale, slowly lower it back down. Repeat.

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your core.
Exhale as you lift your leg, and inhale as you lower it.
Please keep your upper body still.
This exercise works the lateral muscles on your legs.

479.name: WALKING SQUATS
479.introduce: Perform a squat position. Walk several steps to your left, then walk back. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please tighten your core.
Inhale as you lower your body down.
Exhale as you push yourself back up.
This exercise works your quadriceps, hamstrings and glutes.

482.name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT
482.introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

483.name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT
483.introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

484.name: BUTT BRIDGE
484.introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

485.name: MODIFIED BURPEES
485.introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Put your hands on the ground and kick your feet backward, then bring your feet back and jump up. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Put your hands between your knees.
Bend your legs to get your hands on the floor instead of bending your body.
You shouldn't feel strain in your back and shoulders.
Do the steps of the exercise as quickly as you can.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
It's a great exercise that we highly recommend to you.

492.name: STANDING HIP CIRCLE
492.introduce: Stand with your hands on your waist. Lift your left leg and move it clockwise in big circles, then move it counterclockwise. Switch legs and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please keep your lifted leg straight.
Please do it slowly to get the better result.
Inhale through your nose and exhale through the mouth.
Breathe in a regular pattern according to your cadence.
This exercise works your hip joints and improves your hip mobility.

508.name: SEATED OVERHEAD TRICEP EXTENSION
508.introduce: Sit on a bench with your back straight. Gently make both hands into a fist and put them together.\n\nRaise your hands overhead, then lower them down behind your head. Raise them up again, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a bench.
Please keep your back straight.
Please keep your upper arms in place.
Looking forward.
Don't shrug.
Breathe in when lowering your hands and breathe out when raising them.
Please squeeze your triceps when raising your hands.
Please tighten your core and stabilize your back.
Please keep your elbows facing forward.
It’s a great exercise for your triceps.

534.name: FORWARD SPINE STRETCH
534.introduce: Sit on the floor with your feet hip width apart. Lift your arms at shoulder height, curl your chin towards your chest. \n\nAs you exhale, draw your abdomen in and use your hands to reach your toes. Inhale and come back. Repeat it.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Exhale as you reach forward, and inhale as you come back.
Pull your toes toward your body.
Bring your shoulders down away from your ears.
This exercise stretches your spine.

536.name: TOE TAP
536.introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground. \n\nRaise your legs to the tabletop position; drop your left foot towards the ground. Tap the ground with your toes; then raise the leg back. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your knee steady as you drop your leg towards the ground.
Exhale as you drop your leg; inhale as you bring it back.

537.name: BUTTERFLY BRIDGE
537.introduce: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides and your knees bent and opened to the sides. \n\nSqueeze and lift your hips off the ground, and bring your knees together; then return to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
It helps to stretch your hip flexors.
This is a good exercise for your pelvic floor muscles and inner thigh muscles.
It builds strength and stability.

539.name: MARCHING HIP RAISES
539.introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground hip-width apart and your arms straight by your sides. \n\nLift your hips up off the ground into a butt bridge position. Lift one knee up towards your chest, and then lower it back without dropping your hips. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes as you lift your hips.
Please don\'t tuck your chin.
Exhale through your mouth as you raise one leg off the ground.
Inhale through your nose as you lower the leg down.

541.name: LEG IN & OUTS
541.introduce: Sit down with your hands behind you on the ground, your legs extended and your upper body leaning backward. \n\nBend your knees, and bring them toward your chest; then fully extend your legs without touching the ground. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do it slowly to feel the squeezing.
Exhale when bringing your knees to your chest, and inhale when extending your legs.
Please don\'t touch the ground when you extend your leg.

547.name: DONKEY KICKS LEFT PULSE
547.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg with your knee at a 90 degree angle until your thigh is parallel with the floor. Squeeze your butt, and raise your left knee up and down rhythmically.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Tighten your abs.
Lift your knee up and down rhythmically.
Don\'t twist your hips.
Don\'t lift your knee higher than your torso.
Breathe naturally.
You will feel the burn in your butt and your thighs.
This exercise works on your butt and your glutes.

548.name: DONKEY KICKS RIGHT PULSE
548.introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg with your knee at a 90 degree angle until your thigh is parallel with the floor. Squeeze your butt, and raise your right knee up and down rhythmically.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Tighten your abs.
Lift your knee up and down rhythmically.
Don\'t twist your hips.
Don\'t lift your knee higher than your torso.
Breathe naturally.
You will feel the burn in your butt and your thighs.
This exercise works on your butt and your glutes.

559.name: ARM SWINGS WITH LATERAL STEPS
559.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, and stretch your arms to the sides. 

Then step back with your left leg to the right side, and cross your arms in front of your chest. You can bend your right leg slightly. 

Go back to the start position, and repeat on the other side.

tips.text: Breathe naturally.
This exercise helps to get your muscles warmed up.

562.name: BENT KNEE SIDE HIP RAISES RIGHT
562.introduce:
Lie on your left side with your elbow down the floor and your knees bent. Place your right hand on your hips. 

Lift your hips up as high as you can, then drop them down without touching the floor. 

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your knees together.
Keep your supporting elbow directly under your shoulder.
Squeeze your obliques when you lift hips.
Don\'t shrug.
Inhale when you lower your hips and exhale when you lift up.
You should feel your abs engage.
This exercise helps strengthen your core and oblique muscles.

563.name: BENT KNEE SIDE HIP RAISES LEFT
563.introduce:
Lie on your right side with your elbow down the floor and your knees bent. Place your left hand on your hips. 

Lift your hips up as high as you can, then drop them down without touching the floor. 

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your knees together.
Keep your supporting elbow directly under your shoulder.
Squeeze your obliques when you lift hips.
Don\'t shrug.
Inhale when you lower your hips and exhale when you lift up.
You should feel your abs engage.
This exercise helps strengthen your core and oblique muscles.

564.name: THE ROLL
564.introduce: Start with lying on your back, and extend your arms out to the sides. \n\nBend your knees to the chest, and lift your legs up toward the ceiling. Then lower your legs and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Keep your legs together all the time.
Don\'t arch your lower back.
Keep your feet off the floor.
Inhale when you lower your legs and exhale when you lift up.
You should feel your lower abs burning.
This exercise works on your abs.

565.name: STARFISH CRUNCH
565.introduce:
Lie on your back with your hands stretched out to your sides. Keep your legs apart with your feet wider than shoulder width apart. 

Raise your left leg up, slightly lift your shoulders off the floor, and reach your right hand to touch the left foot. 

Return to the starting position, and repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Don\'t strain your neck.
Exhale when you lift leg up, and inhale when you lower down.
If this is too hard for you, just reach your hand to touch the opposite knee.
You can feel your rectus abdominis and obliques burning.
This exercise is great for working the obliques and rectus abdominis.

566.name: SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBER
566.introduce:
Start in a high plank position. 

Exhale as you squeeze your glutes, bend your left knee towards your chest, and keep your right leg straight. Inhale as you return to the plank position, then switch legs.

Repeat slowly and maintain a slow, controlled pace with steady breath.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your abs tight.
Keep your spine neutral and stable.
Keep your body straight.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don\'t lift your hips up.
Exhale when you bend your knee, and inhale when you stretch straight.
If this is too hard for you, put your hands on a bench.
This is a great core exercise for working on your abs, glutes and hip flexors.

567.name: SINGLE LEG DROPS
567.introduce: Lie on your back, and put your hands under your hips for support. Keep your legs straight, and lift them up towards the ceiling. \n\nEngage your core and drop your left leg down slowly until it almost touches the ground. Then raise the leg back up to starting position, and switch to your right leg.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
Keep your legs as straight as possible.
Don\'t arch your lower back.
Inhale when you drop your leg down and exhale when you raise.
If this is too hard for you, slightly bend your knees.
You should feel the burn in your lower abs.
This exercise strengthens your lower abs and thighs.

579.name: STANDING CROSSOVER TOE TOUCHES
579.introduce:
Stand straight with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart. Lift your arms to the sides at shoulder height, and bend your knees slightly. 

Then push your hips back, bend your body and touch the left toe with your right hand. Return to the starting position. 

Switch sides and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your back straight the whole time.
Exhale when you bend your body down, and inhale when you get up.
If it is too hard for you, bend in your knees more when you reach for your toes.
You should feel your oblique muscles burning.
This exercise helps tone your obliques and improve core strength.

580.name: HIGH KNEE WITH TWIST
580.introduce: Stand straight with your arms stretched out to the sides. Then lift your left knee as possible as you can, and twist your torso to the left. \n\nSwitch side and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your lifted leg in place when twisting your torso.
Keep your spine straight.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise helps stretch your spine and external obliques.

583.name: CHEST PALM RESISTING
583.introduce: Stand straight. Place your hands together in front of your chest in a praying posture. \n\nStrain your pectoral muscles, and press your hands against each together. Hold this position.

tips.text: Keep your back straight.
Breathe naturally.
You should feel the tension in your pectoral muscles.
This exercise can strengthen your pectoral muscles.

588.name: STANDING OBLIQUE CRUNCHES LEFT
588.introduce: Stand with your left hand lifted overhead and right hand on your waist. \n\nBring your left elbow and left knee to meet each other. Stretch out and repeat.

tips.text: Try not to let your lifted feet touch the ground.
You can hold a wall or chair to keep balance.
Exhale when crunching, and inhale when stretching out.
Do it slowly to fully stimulate your obliques.
Please keep your hips in place.

589.name: STANDING OBLIQUE CRUNCHES RIGHT
589.introduce: Stand with your right hand lifted overhead and left hand on your waist. \n\nBring your right elbow and right knee to meet each other. Stretch out and repeat.

tips.text: Try not to let your lifted feet touch the ground.
You can hold a wall or chair to keep balance.
Exhale when crunching, and inhale when stretching out.
Do it slowly to fully stimulate your obliques.
Please keep your hips in place.

590.name: DOUBLE CHOP KNEE UPS
590.introduce: Stand with your left foot forward. Lift your arms overhead and interlock your hands. \n\nLift your right knee and lower your hands to the outside of your right thigh. Do it twice, then switch side and repeat.

tips.text: Please keep your abs tight.
Please keep your upper body straight.
Exhale as you lift your knee, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise works your core, and it can also get your heart rate up.

607.name: WIDE LEGGED FORWARD FOLD
607.introduce:
Stand with your feet wide apart. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and open your chest. Exhale slowly to hinge at your hips and fold your torso forward from your hips, keeping your back long. Place your hands on the floor.

Hold the position with deep, steady breaths. With each exhale, relax and allow your body to sink deeper.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back flat.
Tighten your abs.
Please squeeze your quadriceps and inner thighs.
You can slightly bend your knees if you feel it’s too hard.
Too hard? You can press your fingertips on a block or something similar.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to soften into the stretch.
This position stretches your inner thighs and hamstrings.
This position relieves tension in your lower back.

608.name: RUNNER'S LUNGE LEFT
608.introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring your left knee forward, and place your left foot on the outside of your left elbow. Drop your right leg on the ground, and try to sink your hips down. Hold this position.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it’s too hard for you, place your hands down on the ground or put yoga blocks under your elbows.
Put your front heel directly under your knee.
Breathe regularly.

609.name: RUNNER'S LUNGE RIGHT
609.introduce: Start with the plank position. Bring your right knee forward, and place your right foot on the outside of your right elbow. Drop your left leg on the ground, and try to sink your hips down. Hold this position.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
If it’s too hard for you, place your hands down on the ground or put yoga blocks under your elbows.
Put your front heel directly under your knee.
Breathe regularly.

610.name: KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT
610.introduce:
Start with your right knee on the ground, and your left leg straight forward. 

Bend your upper body to touch your left leg. Hold this position. 

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

611.name: KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT
611.introduce:
Start with your left knee on the ground, and your right leg straight forward. 

Bend your upper body to touch your right leg. Hold this position. 

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

612.name: EASY KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT
612.introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Take a big step forward with your left foot.

Inhale as you lower your right knee to the mat. Place your hands on the floor on either side of your right foot. Shift your weight backward and straighten your front leg. Exhale as you gently sink your hips towards the floor. 

Hold this position. Allow your body to relax and sink deeper into the stretch with each exhale.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your left thigh.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

613.name: EASY KNEELING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT
613.introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Take a big step forward with your right foot.

Inhale as you lower your left knee to the mat. Place your hands on the floor on either side of your left foot. Shift your weight backward and straighten your front leg. Exhale as you gently sink your hips towards the floor. 

Hold this position. Allow your body to relax and sink deeper into the stretch with each exhale.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch of your right thigh.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position can stretch your hamstrings.

614.name: BUTTERFLY POSE
614.introduce:
Sit with the soles of your feet together. Draw your heels towards your hips, and press your knees down as much as possible. 

Place your hands in front of you, lean forward and lower your upper body as close to the ground as possible. Hold this position. 

Each time you exhale, try harder to reach for the floor with your body.

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Press your knees down as much as possible.
Breathe deeply.
Keep your sit bones down.
You should feel the stretch in your thighs.
This position can open up your hips and thighs.
This position helps stretch your thighs.

615.name: EASY BUTTERFLY POSE
615.introduce:
Sit with the soles of your feet together. Draw your heels towards your hips, and gently press your knees down.

Exhale, hinge forward from your hips, reaching your hands toward the floor. 

Hold this position. Inhale to lift and extend through your spine, exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Press your knees down as much as possible.
Inhale to extend your spine. Exhale to relax your hips and deepen the stretch.
Keep your sit bones down.
You should feel the stretch in your thighs.
This position can open up your hips and thighs.
This position helps stretch your thighs.

628.name: FROG POSE
628.introduce: Start with your knees under your hips. Open your thighs wide apart as much as possible. \n\nLower your upper body, and use your forearms to support you on the ground. Hold this position.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Keep your core tight.
Keep your tailbone tucked down.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This position stretches your inner thighs, groin and hips.

632.name: STANDING HALF FORWARD FOLD
632.introduce: Stand with your feet wider than hip-width apart, and put your hands on your hips. Squeeze your shoulder blades, curve your back and draw your belly toward the ground as much as possible. \n\nThen squeeze your glutes, and lift your torso up slowly. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your core tight.
Keep your legs straight.
Exhale when you bend your torso forward, and inhale when you lift up.
This exercise can stretch your hamstrings and back muscles.

635.name: STANDARD SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT
635.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Draw your left leg to your upper body with your hands. Keep your left leg as close to your chest as possible. Hold this position. 

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Breathe regularly.

636.name: STANDARD SUPINE HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT
636.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight. 

Draw your right leg to your upper body with your hands. Keep your right leg as close to your chest as possible. Hold this position. 

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your lifted leg straight.
Breathe regularly.

637.name: STANDARD SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT
637.introduce:
Sit with your legs extended in front of you. Bend your right leg with your right foot close to your left thigh. 

Lean your upper body forward to touch the ground. Hold this position. 

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch on the back of your left thigh.
This exercise can stretch your thighs and hamstrings.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Breathe regularly.

638.name: STANDARD SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT
638.introduce:
Sit with your legs extended in front of you. Bend your left leg with your left foot close to your right thigh. 

Lean your upper body forward to touch the ground. Hold this position. 

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch on the back of your right thigh.
This exercise can stretch your thighs and hamstrings.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Breathe regularly.

639.name: SINGLE LEG SWINGS LEFT
639.introduce: Stand in front of the wall. Put your hands on the wall, and swing your left leg from side to side. Please swing your leg as high as possible.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale gently as you swing your leg to one side
Inhale as the leg swings across to the other side.
This position stretches your inner thighs and hamstrings.

641.name: SINGLE LEG SWINGS RIGHT
641.introduce: Stand in front of the wall. Put your hands on the wall, and swing your right leg from side to side. Please swing your leg as high as possible.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale gently as you swing your leg to one side
Inhale as the leg swings across to the other side.
This position stretches your inner thighs and hamstrings.

642.name: SIDE LUNGE STRETCH
642.introduce: Stand with your legs wide apart, and hold your hands together in front of your chest. \n\nLower your body and transfer your weight to your right leg while keeping your left leg straight. Switch side and repeat.

tips.text: Tighten your abs.
Keep your extended leg straight.
This position stretches your hamstrings and hips.
This position strengthens your abs, hips and legs.
Inhale when you go up, and exhale when you go down.

643.name: DOWNWARD DOG LEFT
643.introduce: Step your left foot forward into a wide stance. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to bend your upper body over your front leg and place your hands on the ground.\n\nKeep both legs straight and draw your chest closer to your left thigh. Hold the position, breathing slowly and deeply.

tips.text: Please keep your legs straight.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw your torso closer to your thigh.
Please try to press your back heel on the ground for a deep stretch.
This position stretches your hamstrings and calves.

644.name: DOWNWARD DOG RIGHT
644.introduce: Step your right foot forward into a wide stance. Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to bend your upper body over your front leg and place your hands on the ground.\n\nKeep both legs straight and draw your chest closer to your right thigh. Hold the position, breathing slowly and deeply.

tips.text: Please keep your legs straight.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw your torso closer to your thigh.
Please try to press your back heel on the ground for a deep stretch.
This position stretches your hamstrings and calves.

693.name: LYING LEG ABDUCTION
693.introduce: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides. Lift your legs until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor. Open your legs to your sides as possible as you can. Return and repeat.\n\nInhale when you open your legs and exhale when you bring them back. This exercise stretches your inner thighs.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch in your inner thighs.
Inhale when you open your legs and exhale when you bring them back.
You should feel the stretch in your inner thighs.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs.

694.name: DYNAMIC LEFT LEG STRETCH
694.introduce:
Shift your weight to the right, bend your right knee and sit your hips back. Stretch your left leg with your toes toward your body. 

Bend your body towards your left leg. Return and repeat. Try to get your body closer and closer to your leg every time you bend your body.

Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up. This exercise stretches your hamstrings and inner thigh.

tips.text: Please pull your toes towards your body.
Keep your back flat.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and inner thigh.

695.name: DYNAMIC RIGHT LEG STRETCH
695.introduce:
Shift your weight to the left, bend your left knee and sit your hips back. Stretch your right leg with your toes toward your body. 

Bend your body towards your right leg. Return and repeat. Try to get your body closer and closer to your leg every time you bend your body.

Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up. This exercise stretches your hamstrings and inner thigh.

tips.text: Please pull your toes towards your body.
Keep your back flat.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and inner thigh.

696.name: WIDE LEG CROSS TOUCH
696.introduce: Start with your legs wide apart. Hinge your hips and fold your upper body forward. Press your both hands alternately on your left and right feet. \n\nExhale when you press your hands down, and inhale when you return. This exercise stretches the back of your legs.

tips.text: Exhale when you press your hands down, and inhale when you return.
You should feel the stretch in the back of your legs.
Try not to bend your knees.
This exercise stretches the back of your legs.

698.name: LUNGE PULSE LEFT
698.introduce: Stand with your right leg a big step forward. Bend your right leg, lower your body while keeping your left leg straight and your heels on the ground. You should feel the stretch in the back of your left leg. \n\nThen slightly stretch your right knee to make your body go up and down. Breathe naturally. This exercise stretches the back of your left leg.

tips.text: Keep your hips facing forward.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Please keep your upper body straight.
Inhale as you lower your body, and exhale as you rise slightly.
This exercise stretches the back of your leg.

699.name: LUNGE PULSE RIGHT
699.introduce: Stand with your left leg a big step forward. Bend your left leg, lower your body while keeping your right leg straight and your heels on the ground. You should feel the stretch in the back of your right leg. \n\nThen slightly stretch your left knee to make your body go up and down. Breathe naturally. This exercise stretches the back of your right leg.

tips.text: Keep your hips facing forward.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Please keep your upper body straight.
Inhale as you lower your body, and exhale as you rise slightly.
This exercise stretches the back of your leg.

700.name: STRETCH LEGS ON THE WALL
700.introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs lifted, and your legs and buttocks against the wall. 

Pull your toes toward your body, then stretch your ankles and try to use your toes to touch the wall. Repeat the exercise.

Breathe naturally. This exercise stretches your calves and hamstrings.

tips.text: Please find a wall.
Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your legs straight.
Please keep your lower back always on the floor.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your calves and hamstrings.

702.name: HANDS MOVE FORWARD
702.introduce: Sit on the floor with your legs straight. Put your hands on your thighs, then alternately move your left and right hands forward until your hands grab your feet. Return and repeat. \n\nBreathe naturally. This exercise stretches your calves and hamstrings.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your legs straight.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your calves and hamstrings.

703.name: FORWARD SPINE STRETCH PULSE
703.introduce: Sit on the floor with your feet hip width apart. Lift your arms at shoulder height, curl your chin towards your chest. Reach your hands forward to touch your toes, then return and repeat.\n\nExhale as you reach forward, and inhale as you return. This exercise stretches your calves, hamstrings and back.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Exhale as you reach forward, and inhale as you return.
Pull your toes toward your body.
Bring your shoulders down away from your ears.
This exercise stretches your calves, hamstrings and back.

706.name: DYNAMIC FROG POSE
706.introduce:
Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position. Open your knees and lower your pelvis until you feel a mild stretch. Turn your toes outward to the sides, so the big toe edge of your feet is on the floor. 

Exhale as you lower your chest towards the floor. Inhale as you slowly move your body forward. Then exhale, ease back. 

Gently rock your hips forward and back. Inhale to lengthen your spine and create space in your body, and exhale to relax deeper into the stretch.

tips.text: Inhale to lengthen your spine and exhale to deepen the stretch in your hips and groin.
Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your tailbone tucked down.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs, groin and hips.

707.name: DYNAMIC HALF SPLITS SIDE BEND LEFT
707.introduce:
Sit with your left leg extended to the left and your right leg bent backward. Raise your right arm overhead and bend your upper body to the left. 

Use your right hand to touch your left foot. Return and repeat. Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up. This exercise stretches your hamstrings.

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.

708.name: DYNAMIC HALF SPLITS SIDE BEND RIGHT
708.introduce:
Sit with your right leg extended to the right and your left leg bent backward. Raise your left arm overhead and bend your upper body to the right. 

Use your left hand to touch your right foot. Return and repeat. Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up. This exercise stretches your hamstrings.

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.

711.name: SUPPORTED SPLITS LEFT
711.introduce:
Start in a long stride position with your left leg in front. Put your hands on the ground for support. 

You can put a Yoga block under your left thigh, and lower your right knee on the ground. Hold this position.

Breathe naturally. This exercise stretches your hamstrings and groin.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Inhale to lengthen the spine and stabilize your posture.
Each time you exhale, let your body sink slightly lower into the stretch.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and groin.

712.name: SUPPORTED SPLITS RIGHT
712.introduce:
Start in a long stride position with your right leg in front. Put your hands on the ground for support. 

You can put a Yoga block under your right thigh, and lower your left knee on the ground. Hold this position.

Breathe naturally. This exercise stretches your hamstrings and groin.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your core tight.
Inhale to lengthen the spine and stabilize your posture.
Each time you exhale, let your body sink slightly lower into the stretch.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and groin.

719.name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH PULSE LEFT
719.introduce:
Start with your left knee forward and your left foot directly under the knee. 

Extend your right leg backward and lower it on the ground. Try to pull your hips up and down.

Breathe naturally. This exercise stretches your thighs and groin.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your front heel directly under the knee.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your thighs and groin.

720.name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH PULSE RIGHT
720.introduce:
Start with your right knee forward and your right foot directly under the knee. 

Extend your left leg backward and lower it on the ground. Try to pull your hips up and down.

Breathe naturally. This exercise stretches your thighs and groin.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your front heel directly under the knee.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your thighs and groin.

721.name: SIDE STEP JACKS
721.introduce:
Stand upright with your feet together and arms by your sides. 

Step one foot out to the side, raise your arms up and bring your hands overhead.

Return, switch sides and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Your arms shouldn\'t be straight when you raise them above your head.
Please adjust your cadence according to your preferences.
Inhale as you raise your arms overhead.
Exhale as you return to the starting position.

738.name: GLUTE KICKBACK PULSE LEFT
738.introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders.

Lift your left leg backward with your toes facing down.

Raise the lifted leg up and down rhythmically.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your lifted leg straight.
Tighten your abs.
Squeeze your butt as you raise your leg.
Keep your lower back straight.
Breathe naturally.
Don\'t twist your hips.
This exercise targets your glutes and also works your hamstrings.

739.name: GLUTE KICKBACK PULSE RIGHT
739.introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders.

Lift your right leg backward with your toes facing down.

Raise the lifted leg up and down rhythmically.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your lifted leg straight.
Tighten your abs.
Squeeze your butt as you raise your leg.
Keep your lower back straight.
Breathe naturally.
Don\'t twist your hips.
This exercise targets your glutes and also works your hamstrings.

800.name: THORACIC SPINE CAT COW
800.introduce:
Kneel down and sit back on your heels. Support your hands on the floor in front of you. 

Push your pelvis forward, and keep your lumbar region still. 

Inhale, and round your upper back. Exhale, and pull your chest out. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your lumbar region still during exercise.
Inhale as you round your upper back, and exhale as you pull your chest out.
This exercise can mobilize your upper back.

801.name: LUMBAR CAT COW
801.introduce:
Start on your knees and elbows. Place your elbows under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. 

Drop your head on the floor, and put your hands on the top of your head. Round your spine while keeping your upper back still. 

Inhale, and drop your pelvis down. Exhale, and round your spine. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper back still during exercise.
Inhale as you drop your pelvis down, and exhale as you round your spine.
This exercise can mobilize your lumbar spine.

802.name: PRONE SCORPION KICKS
802.introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs extended. Spread your arms out to the sides with your palms down on the ground.

Lift your left leg off the floor and cross it over to your right side, trying to touch your toes to the floor.

Return to the starting position, and repeat with the other side.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please exercise within your range of motion to avoid straining your lower back.
This exercise stretches your hip flexors and lower back.
Breathe regularly.

821.name: THREAD THE NEEDLE LEFT
821.introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.

Inhale, extend your left arm up toward the ceiling, rotating your chest open to the left. Exhale, thread your left arm underneath your body, lowering your left shoulder and the side of your head to the floor. Extend your right arm forward.

Hold for a few seconds. With each inhale, lengthen the spine; with each exhale, deepen the stretch. Return your right arm and repeat the pose.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your hips directly above your knees during the exercise.
Don\'t collapse your right shoulder into your neck.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and upper back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax into the twist.

822.name: THREAD THE NEEDLE RIGHT
822.introduce:
Start on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.

Inhale, extend your right arm up toward the ceiling, rotating your chest open to the right. Exhale, thread your right arm underneath your body, lowering your right shoulder and the side of your head to the floor. Extend your left arm forward.

Hold for a few seconds. With each inhale, lengthen the spine; with each exhale, deepen the stretch. Return your left arm and repeat the pose.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your hips directly above your knees during the exercise.
Don't collapse your left shoulder into your neck.
This exercise stretches your shoulders and upper back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax into the twist.

835.name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ LEFT
835.introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your left leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your right leg forward. Put your left hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the left. Bend your right elbow and hook it on the outside of your left knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your left shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

836.name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ RIGHT
836.introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your right leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your left leg forward. Put your right hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the right. Bend your left elbow and hook it on the outside of your right knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your right shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

855.name: WALK THE DOG
855.introduce: Start on all fours. Exhale as you lift your hips into an inverted ‘V’ shape, and lengthen your spine.\n\nAlternately lift and lower your heels with steady breath.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Keep a steady and even breathing rhythm without holding your breath.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

915.name: PUPPY DOG POSE
915.introduce:
Sit on your heels with your knees hip-width apart. 

Take a deep inhale and walk your hands forward, keeping your hips stacked over your knees. Exhale as you lower your chest and forehead toward the mat, and lift your hips stacked above your knees.

Hold this position with slow, steady breaths. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. On each exhale, let your chest sink deeper, releasing the shoulders and upper back.

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine.  Exhale to sink your chest closer to the mat.
Keep your hips directly above your knees.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body and tight shoulders.

920.name: OPEN WING POSE LEFT
920.introduce:
Lie on your stomach with legs straight. Extend your left arm out to the side with your palm facing down in line with your shoulder.

Inhale, then exhale as you roll your body to the right. Place your right foot behind your left leg for support. Keep your head slightly lifted, neck in line with the spine.

Hold this position. Inhale to open the chest, exhale to relax into the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Inhale to open the chest. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
This pose helps relieve stress and tension throughout your shoulders.

921.name: OPEN WING POSE RIGHT
921.introduce:
Lie on your stomach with legs straight. Extend your right arm out to the side with your palm facing down in line with your shoulder.

Inhale, then exhale as you roll your body to the left. Place your left foot behind your right leg for support. Keep your head slightly lifted, neck in line with the spine.

Hold this position. Inhale to open the chest, exhale to relax into the stretch.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Inhale to open the chest. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
This pose helps relieve stress and tension throughout your shoulders.

942.name: BENT ARM CIRCLES
942.introduce: Bend your arms with your fingers touching your shoulders.\n\nRotate your elbows clockwise in big circles several times, then rotate counterclockwise.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
This exercise works your upper and inner chest muscles.
This exercise helps warm up your shoulders and activate your upper body.

943.name: BENT ARM UP & DOWN
943.introduce: Lift your arms at shoulder height. Bend your arms at a 90 degree angle with your forearms parallel to the floor. \n\nLift your arms, and every time you lower them, it's like you are hitting down the air as hard as you can. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
Don't shrug your shoulders when lifting your arms.
This exercise helps reduce the armpit fat.

944.name: PRAYER PUSH
944.introduce: Press your palms together in front of your chest in a prayer position. \n\nRaise your arms up and down. Press your palms against each other throughout the exercise.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
Feel the squeeze on your chest.
Press your palms against each other throughout the exercise.

945.name: PRAYER SQUEEZE
945.introduce: Press your palms together in front of your chest in a prayer position.\n\nSqueeze your elbows against each other, then return and repeat.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
Feel the squeeze on your chest.
Keep your palms squeezed against each other throughout the exercise.

946.name: ELBOW TAPS
946.introduce:
Bend your arms at a 90 degree angle in front of you with your palms facing you. 

Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor. 

Alternately tap the opposite forearm with your elbow.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your core engaged.
Feel the squeeze on your chest.

947.name: BENT ARM CHEST FLY
947.introduce:
Bend your arms at a 90 degree angle to your sides. 

Keep your upper arms parallel to the floor and palms facing forward. 

Push your forearms together and press them against each other, then return and repeat.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
Feel the squeeze on your chest.
Press your forearms against each other as hard as you can.
Keep your arms at a 90 degree angle.

948.name: CUBAN ROTATION
948.introduce: Bend your arms at a 90 degree angle to your sides with your forearms perpendicular to the ground. \n\nKeep your upper arms in line with your shoulders and parallel to the floor. Rotate your forearms up and down.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your upper arms in line with your shoulders.

951.name: WALL SLIDE
951.introduce:
Start with your back against the wall. Slide your body downward, keeping your knees slightly bent to keep your body stable.

Bend your arms at a 90 degree angle to your sides and press them on the wall.

Exhale and drive your arms up along the wall. Inhale and pull your arms down. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your back against the wall.
Keep your core engaged.
Exhale on the way up and inhale on the way down.
This exercise can fire up your back and shoulder muscles.

1284.name: KNEELING TRICEPS EXTENSION
1284.introduce: Kneel down with legs together. Lower your body to the floor with both elbows and hands shoulder width apart. Lean forward and support yourself by your forearms.\n\nExhale and extend your elbows to push your body off the floor until arms are straight. Pause for a count, inhale and lower your body to the starting position slowly and repeat.

tips.text: Do not lock out your elbows at the top.
To add difficulty, either move your knees backward or lean forward.
Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Exhale as you extend your elbows and press up.
Inhale as you lower your body with control.

1336.name: CROSS ARM UP & DOWN
1336.introduce:
Cross your arms at shoulder height.

Lift your crossed arms overhead and lower them to the starting position. Keep your neck neutral and relaxed.

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your neck neutral and relaxed.

1338.name: PALMS OVERHEAD CHEST FLY
1338.introduce:
Put your hands in a prayer pose above your head.

Open your elbows outward and then bring them together.

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your neck neutral and relaxed.
This exercise strengthens the muscles surrounding your boobs.

1339.name: ARM CROSSOVER
1339.introduce: Bend your elbows in front of you with your arms parallel to the floor.\n\nCross your arms twice with your left arm over your right arm. Swap the position of your arms and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Keep your arms at shoulder height.
Don't use momentum when crossing your arms.
This exercise provides plenty of stimulation to develop the breast muscles.
Breathe regularly.

1340.name: BENT-OVER ARM LIFT LEFT
1340.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Lean your body forward.

Hang your arms down naturally, and place your left hand on your right hand.

Lift your left hand to your armpit and then place it back on your right hand.

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.

1341.name: BENT-OVER ARM LIFT RIGHT
1341.introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Lean your body forward.

Hang your arms down naturally, and place your right hand on your left hand.

Lift your right hand to your armpit and then place it back on your left hand.

Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.

1342.name: X CROSS
1342.introduce:
Cross your arms in an "X" shape in front of your forehead with your fingers spread.

Make a fist with your hands and pull your elbows down to the sides of your body.

Switch arms and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Breathe regularly.
Keep your back straight.
This exercise lifts and firms your breasts.

1449.name: MERMAID LEFT
1449.introduce:
